passage_1.title: The Gulf Stream and Global Warming

question_groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B, or C.

1.question: Labrador and London are similar in
options: A. climate.
B. distance from the North Pole.
C. abundance of wildlife.

2.question: Europe can support a large population because
options: A. it has a lot of fresh water.
B. it is at the proper latitude.
C. it has a good climate for farming.

3.question: When the Gulf Stream reaches the North Atlantic, it sinks because
options: A. it has become colder.
B. it has become less salty.
C. it is blown by the winds.

4.question: Ocean currents help make life on Earth possible because they
options: A. enable marine life to travel.
B. maintain suitable temperatures.
C. regulate glacial melt.

5.question: In 2007, the number of vortices, or chimneys, that pulled the waters of the Gulf Stream down toward the ocean floor was
options: A. zero.
B. one.
C. seven.

6.question: During the most recent Little Ice Age,
options: A. the Gulf Stream slowed down significantly.
B. Europe was affected only slightly.
C. glaciers covered much of North America.

7.question: In the past, climate change has happened
options: A. at regular intervals.
B. gradually over time.
C. very quickly.
